gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI Provisional Estimates of GDP for Q1 FY2026-27 (constant prices, YoY), released August 31, 2026. Real GDP grew 7.8% in Q1 FY27 vs 6.9% in Q1 FY26 — flat versus Q4 FY25-26's 7.8% (per MoSPI Q4/PE FY26 press note, June 2026), so growth momentum is holding rather than accelerating further.

cpi.source: MoSPI Consumer Price Index press release for August 2026 (provisional, base year 2024=100), released September 14, 2026. Up from 4.45% in July 2026; food inflation at 5.95%. Remains inside RBI's 2–6% tolerance band but above the 4% target.

gsec10y.source: RBI Weekly Statistical Supplement 10Y benchmark yield (FIMMDA-computed); cross-checked via market data aggregators. Yield crossed 7% in September 2026 for the first time in over three months, up ~17 bps over the past month, driven by crude oil price gains, a global bond sell-off, and RBI liquidity-stance uncertainty.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC held the repo rate at 5.25% for a 4th consecutive review (unanimous 6-0 vote), maintaining a neutral stance. Governor Malhotra cited the need for greater clarity on the inflation outlook before further action. Next MPC resolution due October 7, 2026.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution, August 5, 2026 (repo rate held at 5.25%, neutral stance).

gov_capex.note: Centre's capital expenditure jumped ~30% YoY to ₹4.51 lakh crore in April–July FY27, meeting 37% of the ₹12.22 lakh crore full-year capex target per CGA data — a faster pace than the comparable period of FY26. Fiscal deficit held at 27% of the FY27 Budget Estimate over the same period, so the capex push has not come at the cost of fiscal discipline.
gov_capex.source: Controller General of Accounts (CGA) monthly fiscal data, reported via Business Standard (~Aug 31, 2026).

china_plus_one.note: India's electronics and engineering exports to China surged ~40% YoY in the five months through August 2026 (PCB assemblies, smartphones, display modules, telecom equipment); engineering exports to China up ~21% YoY in April–August. PLI-driven China+1 manufacturing investment has reached ₹1.76 lakh crore realized (~USD 20.3 bn) across 14 sectors with over 12 lakh jobs created — reorientation thesis remains active.
china_plus_one.source: Bloomberg / BusinessToday trade-data reporting (Sept 21, 2026); PIB PLI scheme progress updates.

rural_recovery.note: Mixed picture: rural FMCG demand grew 11% YoY in Q4 FY26, outpacing urban demand for a 5th straight quarter on improving rural real wages and MSP hikes. But the SW Monsoon 2026 ended ~14% deficient nationally as of Sept 7 (sharpest shortfall in recent years), with the southern peninsula 27% below normal; cumulative kharif sowing is tracking ~1-2% below last year (though the deficit narrowed sharply from ~23% in June to single digits by end-July). Net: consumption-side tailwinds offset by a genuine monsoon shortfall — upgraded from 'weak' to 'neutral' versus the prior refresh.
rural_recovery.source: IMD SW Monsoon 2026 season-end data; NielsenIQ Q4 FY26 rural FMCG demand report; ICRA kharif sowing estimates.
